name: flashcard-maker
description: Turn a word list into printable double-sided flashcards and an import file for spaced-repetition apps. Use a spreadsheet with word, reading (phonetic or pinyin), meaning, example and tags, or a plain text list. Cards are laid out 8, 9, 10, 12, 18 or 24 to a page, with backs mirrored so they line up when you print double-sided (long or short edge). Text shrinks to fit, cut lines and card numbers help when cutting, and you can reverse the cards to practise meaning → word. Edit or skip cards, then export the PDF, an Anki import file with tags, and a CSV for Quizlet and others. Runs locally; no app account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把词表变成可以双面打印的单词卡，以及可以导入背诵软件的文件。可以用表格（单词、音标/拼音、释义、例句、标签），也可以用纯文本词表。每页 8、9、10、12、18 或 24 张，背面自动镜像排版，双面打印（长边或短边翻转）后正反面对齐。文字自动缩放，带裁切虚线和卡片编号；也可以反向制作（看释义想单词）。可以修改或跳过个别卡片，然后导出打印 PDF、带标签的 Anki 导入文件和通用 CSV（Quizlet 等）。在本地运行，不用登录任何 App，无需 API 密钥。
